AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#673 @ dcf095b85f74478f44e1a090f2a93cbbd1c6d496 — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/2

Reviewer: agent 119, AUD-SOL-T5-119. **Job-required closure attestation at the unchanged T3 head, strictly for the T1–T5 land-as-one train. T3 is not approved to land or deploy alone.** The runtime closure lives in #707 `ffed434eda9048d396c4921c22b1d41a1b84b464`, not in this unchanged tree; new **B-707-1 draft-finalization/payment** still blocks that piece and the whole train. This supersedes the prior T3 verdict only for the narrowed uncollectible finding under that explicit split-stack dependency; it is not a merge-eligibility claim. [Prior Sol T3 verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5985038558), [T5 candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707), [Independent draft failure and retained replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

### Prior findings first / closure evidence

**B-673-1, narrowed uncollectible counterexample — CLOSED in #707.** The exact preserved Sol T3E probe passes **8/8** on the T5 runtime: both `past_due`/`unpaid` uncollectible payers now cause retry with no DELETE; both original open-payment controls remain green; delayed active delivery keeps paid entitlement. Complete open/uncollectible pages are read before the paid history, every captured member requires confirmed void, and ownership is renewed by CAS before each void and cancellation. Unknown/partial pages, unconfirmed voids, more than ten ids and ownership loss fail closed in passing candidate tests. [Independent CI 37242191712](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

**C-673-9 lease/recovery half — CLOSED in #707.** Per-call renewal replaces the old fixed `(n+1)*20s` budget; the multi-invoice and busy-second-worker regressions pass. The earlier uncollectible half is disposed under B-673-1 above, not silently relabeled C. [Independent candidate regressions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

**The generalized paid-plan safety boundary is still blocked as B-707-1**, because a draft excluded from those pages can finalize/pay after the snapshot and the top still DELETEs paid access. That new T5-domain finding stays on its owning piece rather than being duplicated as a T3 blocker; do not use this closure to land the train. [Executed new counterexample](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

### Follow-ups (C)

- **C-673-1, carried:** `src/checkout/checkout.module.ts:49-83`; qualify #680/full recurring-trials composition with one reservation/release authority, capability registration, typed trial parameters, unified webhook state, mobile #338 and configured trial-ending event before deployment. [Existing qualification](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5984422742).
- **C-673-8, carried:** T3 `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:286-296` and `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts:966-972`; a void-driven active event or failed DELETE can supersede an unpaid conflict and produce an inaccurate billed/refund alert. Persist fenced void intent and reconcile active truth against actual positive-payment evidence; group with #680 C-673-4 and new C-707-2 partial-void reconciliation. This residual does not include B-707-1 paid-client access loss. [Prior independent disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5985038558).

### Evidence applicability / CI / default

No other model's verdict borrowed. This is continuation from own fully reviewed T3 RC evidence plus full independent #707 diff review and exact retained-probe replay; T3 source is unchanged, #673 → #706 source equality and exact T5 probe/source equality were verified. No approved-original-#656 evidence is newly claimed. Independent lane **153 pass / 2 failures**, with only the new T5 draft cases red; builder before **32 fail / 65 pass**, after **276/276 + tsc** independently read. [Prior own review](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5985038558), [Independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712), [Builder before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37240926785), [Builder after](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37241269037).

T3 remains **2,999 lines**, grandfathered below 3,000, with 10 distinct applicable checks successful and deploy-readiness skipped; main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM remain owed. **Recommended default: retain this narrowly scoped closure, hold the entire train for B-707-1, fix that draft boundary now, then obtain dual T5 exact-head deltas and the later main/recurring restack qualification.** [T3 checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673/checks), [T5 scope and landing dependency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707).
